rationale: The child directive's operative text is unavailable, and its title alone identifies a person-specific exemption from compulsory retirement for age. C11 is the strongest candidate because it is also an individualized executive-order exception concerning federal personnel rights, but it modifies a reemployment time limit rather than retirement rules and supplies no demonstrably shared language or machinery. C20 is another unpublished, person-specific personnel order, but its subject is designation of an acting judge and no text permits comparison. C09 concerns federal reemployment rights more generally, yet its expiration and rulemaking provisions do not correspond materially to an age-retirement exemption. No displayed candidate plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template on the supplied evidence.
